source: Trend datasets built on 2026-10-24 from SEC companyfacts through the backend pipeline itself (normalize_companyfacts, upsert_facts_bulk, trend_analysis.dataset.build_dataset) into a scratch SQLite database, then slimmed to the twelve concepts the trend charts plot and the quality fields the data notes read (qoq fields and provenance operands dropped; the server data_notes block kept, with its references limited to those concepts, so letters stay as the server assigns them). REGNPN is REGN with nine legacy_calculation review flags simulated through the backend’s own data_notes(). Values are filed figures; nothing is recalculated here.
